title: LEAPWare BuildCraft policy
description: A policy file configures each registered rule's mode. An absent or malformed policy resolves every rule to 'off' (fail-open) rather than raising; see docs/policy.md#fail-open.

rules.description: Keyed by rule_id (see core/lwb_core/rules/__init__.py for the registry).

mode.description: off: rule never runs. warn: finding is surfaced but never blocks. deny: finding blocks the action.

options.description: Rule-specific configuration. See docs/rules/<rule_id>.md for the options a given rule reads.
